_comment: OPTIONAL ADVANCED EXAMPLE — not the plugin v1 default. Prefer stdio (${CPC_ROOT}/servers/*.exe) from mcp.json / mcp.optionals.example.json. Use shared-host HTTP only on machines that already run the cpc shared-mcp daemon. Do NOT invent an HTTP path (/sse or otherwise): set each url to match the shared-host MCP endpoint from that machine's Cursor mcp.json. Autonomous is a paid wedge and MUST NOT appear in free Toolbelt wire examples.
_ports_comment: Defaults only. Each install can use its own ports: override per service with env CPC_PORT_<SERVICE> or a %CPC_ROOT%\shared-mcp\ports.json file, then run `node scripts/resolve-ports.mjs --servers` to get the urls for this machine. Autonomous is a paid wedge and has no free-pack port.

cpc-hands._comment: EXAMPLE SHAPE ONLY — replace url with the real shared-host endpoint from local Cursor mcp.json on a daemon host. Port shown is the default; use resolve-ports.mjs for this machine.

cpc-manager._comment: Optional. Port 7774 = manager. Merge only if opted in.

cpc-voice._comment: Optional. Port 7776 = voice. Voice may not always be running.

cpc-programmer._comment: Directed only (never default on Cursor). Port 7777 = programmer.
